tips.text: Rank the Lato to 30 before building; the recipe consumes it, and its Mastery needs a second build otherwise.
Rank a Bolto to 30 before Akbolto or Hystrix consumes it.
Rank the Lato and farm the materials while the build runs; the 12-hour timer is the only waiting.
Keep your Lato and Bolto until the recipes are done; the game gives no warning when you sell an ingredient weapon.
Nobody complains about the Bolto itself; the grumbling is about the Akbolto and Hystrix tree around it.
